item.title: Overdose at Talbot Gardens
item.description: Simcoe's Talbot Gardens arena was the scene of a drug overdose last week; the second reported instance in the past 14 months.

item.title: Lions Clubs team up to support hospice
item.description: Local Lions Clubs have joined forces in hopes of making a major donation to the Norfolk Haldimand Community Hospice.

item.title: Ticket to fun for Haldimand’s silver anniversary
item.description: A visit to a park or public building in Haldimand County could have a silver lining this year.

item.title: Lengthy custody before conviction nets man extra credit
item.description: A North York man who shot and injured a woman in a Simcoe apartment in 2022 was released from jail when he finally came to court for sentencing in 2025.

item.title: Library’s Literary Prize Awards handed out
item.description: The Norfolk County Public Library recently handed out its 2025 Norfolk Literary Prize Awards at a ceremony at the Vittoria Community Centre.

item.title: Townsend’s Jim Midgley makes hockey history
item.description: Midgley made history by joining the Toronto Sceptres in July 2024 as the first coach to work in both the NHL and Professional Women’s Hockey League.
